children.name: Version-Specific OpenAI Instrumentor Initialization
children.description: Detect OpenAI library version at runtime and apply the appropriate instrumentation strategy: delegate to legacy instrumentor for v0, or proceed with standard v1 initialization. Ensures instrumentation compatibility across library versions by routing initialization logic based on version detection.
